quote: Our family photo shoot was a dream come true and Lisa went above and beyond all expectations! I would give 10 stars! She was amazing at putting it all together with such a large group and also working quickly with timing the sun coming through the clouds to create the perfect pictures. Our photo shoot went so smoothly and perfectly! I highly recommend It’s A Keeper Photography for anyone who wants the best quality photos and a fun time with Lisa’s jovial personality!
name: Gayla Worlund
